question: A honey farm had 101 jars of honey ready at the start of harvest. A bumper crop turned every jar into 5 jars. The farm mentioned that 20 extra jar lids were also bought, though that had nothing to do with the jar count. A local co-op then added 64 more jars, a delivery that took '120 minutes, or two hours' to unload. A wholesale buyer then took 162 jars. Finally, 14 more jars were added from a late harvest. How many jars of honey were there after the late harvest?

Bianca had 219 friendship bracelets in a display box, while her friend Talon had 90 bracelets in his. A craft fair trade turned every bracelet she had into 2 bracelets. She then gave away 128 bracelets to classmates. She donated 282 more bracelets to a school fundraiser, a drive that took '60 minutes, or one hour' to organize. A final bulk order turned every remaining bracelet into 3 bracelets. How many bracelets did Bianca have after the final bulk order?

A vineyard had 70 crates of grapes ready at harvest. A bumper crop turned every crate into 3 crates. A second bumper crop turned each of those into 7 crates. A third bumper crop turned every crate into 5 crates. Finally, a large wine producer bought 2237 crates in one order. How many crates of grapes were left after the wine producer's order?

In the morning, a bakery had 55 loaves of bread ready. By midday, 10 more loaves were baked, and in the afternoon the loaf count tripled when a wholesale order came in. That evening, a second bulk order turned every loaf into 7 loaves. Right after, 29 more loaves were baked for a late order. Before closing, 1282 loaves were sold to a grocery chain. A final matching order turned every remaining loaf into 3 loaves. How many loaves of bread were there after the final matching order?

Nadia had 51 friendship bracelets in her collection, while her friend Ines had 30 bracelets in hers. Nadia made 18 more bracelets over the weekend, a project that took '60 minutes, or one hour.' She then received 17 more bracelets as a gift. A friend gave her 44 more bracelets from an old collection. Finally, she made 7 more bracelets by hand. How many bracelets did Nadia have after making the last batch?

Owen had 236 baseball cards in his binder, while his rival Zeke had 100 cards in his. His card count doubled when he opened a rare booster box, and a second trade turned every card into 7 cards. He then received 79 more cards as a birthday gift. A third trade turned every card into 5 cards, and a fourth trade turned each of those into 8 cards. Finally, he found 28 more cards in an old shoebox. How many cards did Owen have after finding the cards in the shoebox?

A charity clothing drive collected 188 sweaters in the first week. A local business donated 19 more sweaters. A school donated 24 more sweaters. A big distribution event then gave away 97 sweaters to families in need. A matching donor turned every remaining sweater into 6 sweaters. Finally, 707 sweaters were shipped to a regional shelter. How many sweaters were left after the shipment to the shelter?

In the morning, a farm stand had 48 pumpkins on display. By midday, a delivery added 31 more pumpkins, and in the afternoon 15 more arrived from a second field. The farmer mentioned a dozen new wheelbarrows had also been bought, though that had nothing to do with the pumpkin count. That evening, 79 pumpkins were sold during a fall festival. Right after, 66 more pumpkins came in from a late harvest, and before closing, 43 more arrived from a neighboring farm. How many pumpkins were on display after the neighboring farm's delivery?

In the morning, a bookstore had 209 novels on the clearance table. By midday, 150 novels were sold during a big sale. The manager mentioned a dozen new bookends had also arrived, though that had nothing to do with the novel count. In the afternoon, a restock turned every remaining novel into 6 novels. That evening, 41 more novels were donated by a local author. Right before closing, 31 more novels arrived from a late shipment. How many novels were on the clearance table after the late shipment?

Leilani had 127 seashells in her collection, while her friend Marisol had 90 shells in hers. Leilani gave away 109 shells to a school art class. She then found 35 more shells during a beach walk, a search that took '120 minutes, or two hours.' Leilani's grandmother mentioned a dozen new beach pails were also bought, though that had nothing to do with the shell count. A shell-multiplying trade then turned every shell into 8 shells, and she then received 25 more shells as a gift. A final trade turned every shell into 7 shells. How many shells did Leilani have after the final trade?

A butterfly garden had 14 chrysalises hanging in the enclosure at the start of spring. A breeding program turned every chrysalis into 5 chrysalises. Then 13 didn't survive the process and had to be removed. The garden's caretaker mentioned a dozen new butterfly nets had also been bought, though that had nothing to do with the chrysalis count. A new batch added 54 more chrysalises. A second batch added 62 more, and a final batch added 68 more chrysalises. How many chrysalises were in the enclosure after the final batch?

A school had 154 basketballs in the gym storage at the start of the season. The coach checked out 55 balls for the varsity team. A donation then added 33 more balls. A supplier's bulk order turned every remaining ball into 8 balls. A local sports store donated 66 more balls. The final count then tripled when a district-wide equipment grant came through. How many basketballs were in the gym storage after the grant?

Priya had 103 beads in her jewelry box, while her friend Sana had 60 beads in hers. Priya received 15 more beads as a gift. She then bought 8 more beads at the craft store. She gave half of her beads to her sister, keeping the rest for herself. A bead-multiplying trade then turned every remaining bead into 4 beads. Finally, she received 51 more beads from her grandmother. How many beads did Priya have after receiving the beads from her grandmother?

Ezra had 140 comic books in his collection, while his friend Milo had 90 comics in his. Ezra gave half of his comics to his younger brother, keeping the rest for himself. He then bought 55 more comics at a convention. A friend gave him 59 more comics as a gift. His remaining comics then tripled when a rare box set arrived. Finally, he received 43 more comics from his uncle. How many comics did Ezra have after receiving the comics from his uncle?

A bookstore had 188 novels in a special display for a book fair. A bulk order turned every novel into 5 novels. During setup, 32 novels were found damaged and removed. A late donation added 53 more novels, arriving after a drive that took '120 minutes, or two hours.' Once the fair opened, 168 novels were sold in the first hour. How many novels were left in the display after the first hour of sales?

Liam started the day with 76 stickers in his collection. In the morning he traded some cards and gained 15 more stickers. By midday he had found another 25 stickers stuck inside an old notebook. In the afternoon, he gave away 93 stickers to classmates for a school project. In the evening, his aunt surprised him with 25 more stickers as a gift. How many stickers does Liam have now?

Sara had $105 saved from her allowance. She earned $64 more helping neighbors with yard work last weekend. Then she spent $77 on a new bicycle helmet. Sara had far more money than her friend Tom, who only had $50 saved up. For her good grades, a relative gave her a bonus that made her savings 3 times as large as before. Sara then divided that money evenly between 2 accounts, one for herself and one for her sister, and kept only her own share. How much money did Sara keep in her own account?

A vending machine's coin box held 163 cents at the start of the school day. During morning cleanup, the janitor removed 93 cents to fix a jammed slot. He then split what remained evenly between 2 identical collection jars and kept only one jar. That afternoon, the office manager added 58 cents in cafeteria change to the jar, and later the school store contributed another 56 cents. For the bank deposit, the treasurer made 8 identical envelopes, each holding that same jar amount, and combined them into one total. Since 100 cents equal 1 dollar, the school always double-checked its coin counts. How many cents did the treasurer send to the bank?

A young gymnast began the week with 52 practice points on her scorecard. Early in the morning session, her coach awarded her 62 more points for perfect landings. By midmorning, 51 points were deducted after she missed a routine. That afternoon, a scoring bonus made her total 5 times as large as it had been. Later, in the evening session, a second bonus round made her new total another 5 times as large again. Since the gym recorded points in tenths and rounded them to whole points at day's end, no fractions ever appeared on the chart. Finally, right before the night's final tally, a completion award added 71 more points. What was the gymnast's final point total?

Before dawn, a shipping warehouse loaded 7 trucks, each carrying 177 identical crates of oranges, onto the loading dock. In the morning, workers unloaded 516 crates to fill an order for a downtown grocery chain. By the afternoon, an inspection found 641 crates had spoiled in the heat and had to be thrown out. In the evening, a late delivery from a nearby farm added 13 more crates to the dock. How many crates of oranges remained on the dock by night?

A phone's battery showed 88 percent charge when Nina left for her hike. During the first hour, streaming music drained 29 percent. Taking photos on a scenic overlook used another 22 percent. A long phone call on the way down cost her 36 percent more. Since her phone reports charge in percent, which is just battery-minutes converted to a fraction of 100, she never worried about the raw units. When she got home, her charger's fast-charge mode brought her battery up to 6 times its drained level before bed. Overnight, a scheduled optimization further pushed it to 5 times that amount by morning. What percent charge did Nina's phone show the next morning?

A community garden plot had 40 tomato plants at the start of spring. Volunteers added 15 more seedlings in early April. A donation from a local nursery brought in 65 additional plants in May. By June, the garden had grown by 32 more plants thanks to a seed-sharing event. When the harvest was divided evenly among 4 neighborhood families, only one family's share continued to be tracked for the community log. That family then lost 6 plants to a late blight. How many tomato plants did that family end up with?

A bakery started the morning with 45 loaves of sourdough bread on the shelf. By midmorning, 11 loaves had been sold to early customers. In the afternoon, the ovens finished a new batch, adding 38 more loaves to the shelf. That evening, a wholesale order required 9 times the afternoon total to be prepared for a chain of cafes. Overnight, the shipment was split evenly among 3 delivery vans. How many loaves did each van carry?

A charity jar held 20 dollars in donations at the start of the fundraiser morning. By midday, the treasurer split the jar evenly between 2 charity boxes and kept tracking only one box, ignoring the 200 raffle tickets that had gone unsold. In the afternoon, a generous donor added 73 dollars to that box. That evening, a matching-donation program grew the box's total to 5 times its size. Overnight, processing fees shrank it back down to one-fifth of that amount by morning, and since 100 cents make 1 dollar, the bank always rounded exactly to the cent. Finally, 82 dollars had to be paid out the next day for venue costs. How much money was left in the box?

A runner logged 62 minutes of training time on Monday. On Tuesday, an injury forced her to cut back, losing 56 minutes from her weekly total. Her coach then required her to make up for it by training for 7 times as long as what remained. On Wednesday, she added 40 more minutes for a recovery jog. Since her coach preferred tracking sessions in hours rather than raw minutes, converting every 60 minutes into 1 hour on the log, the team still recorded exact minutes for precision. By the end of the week, a bonus endurance session made her total grow to 3 times its size. How many minutes of training did the runner log by the end of the week?
